title: Commercial Property & Corporate Legal Assistant
company: Clear Legal & Financial Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
A fantastic opportunity has arisen for two experienced Legal Assistants to join a busy and expanding Commercial Property & Corporate department, with one position based in Harrogate and the other in Skipton.

The successful candidates will provide comprehensive administrative and legal support to fee earners, helping to ensure matters are managed efficiently and clients receive a high standard of service.

Previous Commercial Property experience is essential. Corporate experience would be an advantage, but is not essential.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to solicitors and fee earners.
- Managing client files and maintaining accurate records using a case management system.
- Preparing correspondence, documents and legal paperwork through audio typing, digital dictation and word processing.
- Managing diaries, arranging appointments and coordinating meetings.
- Handling incoming calls, emails and client enquiries professionally.
- Opening, organising and archiving legal files.
- Preparing client bills and maintaining account ledgers.
- Supporting Commercial Property transactions, including:

o Ordering property searches and completing client ID checks.

o Assisting with exchanges and completions.

o Liaising with the Land Registry and handling registrations.
- Supporting Corporate matters with document preparation, file management and general administrative duties.
- Preparing court documentation and electronic bundles where required.
- Providing general support to colleagues and the wider department.

Requirements
- Previous experience working as a Legal Assistant or Legal Secretary within a law firm.
- Commercial Property experience is essential and non-negotiable.
- Previous Corporate legal experience is desirable but not essential.
- Strong audio typing, word processing and document preparation skills.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and legal case management systems.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Confident communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Working Hours
- Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm.
- One-hour lunch break.

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established and growing legal practice offering a supportive working environment and the opportunity to develop within a busy specialist department.

Should you have any questions or wish to apply please do not hesitate to contact Clear Legal and Financial.

Please Note: Due to the number of applications we receive we may be unable to respond to every application directly. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days please assume your application has been unsuccessful.

title: Legal Administrator
description:
We are delighted to be partnering with a well-respected, established firm to recruit a Legal Assistant to join their Private Client team in Bedale.

This is a great opportunity to join a professional and supportive team. It suits an experienced Legal Assistant, or a strong legal administrator who is keen to build a career in Private Client work.

The Role

You'll provide comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to lawyers and legal staff, helping the department run smoothly and efficiently. You'll maintain accurate case files, coordinate diaries and meetings, and be a professional, friendly point of contact for clients.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing secretarial and administrative support to lawyers within the Private Client team
- Preparing, formatting and proofreading legal documents, correspondence and reports
- Managing diaries, scheduling appointments and coordinating meetings via Outlook
- Maintaining well-organised electronic and paper filing systems
- Keeping case files complete, accurate and up to date
- Handling incoming calls and correspondence professionally and courteously
- Managing competing priorities to meet deadlines
- Providing reception cover during lunchtimes, holidays and other absences

About You

Essential:
- Experience as a Legal Secretary or in a similar administrative role, ideally within a legal environment
- Excellent typing skills and a high level of accuracy
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a professional, client-focused manner
- Able to work independently while contributing positively to a team

Desirable:
- Previous Private Client experience
- Experience using a legal case management system
- Experience supporting lawyers with client matters and legal documentation

Private Client experience isn't essential. Candidates with strong legal secretarial or administrative experience who are keen to develop in this area are also encouraged to apply.

Apply today or get in touch with Katie Kendall in our Northallerton office.

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Residential Assistant
- Annual Salary: £25,500 - £29,000 depending on experience level
- Location: Selby Office
- Job Type: Full-time
- Working Hours: Monday to Friday 9-5pm

We are seeking a Residential Assistant to join our client's team in Selby. This role is ideal for individuals with a keen interest in Residential Property, offering a great opportunity for long-term development and progression within the firm.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Document Production: Prepare accurate legal documents and correspondence, amend and format complex legal documents, manage incoming and outgoing mail, and ensure compliance with storage and management of client deeds and documents.
- File & Case Management: Open, maintain, and close client files using the firm's case management system, maintain accurate and timely filing systems, and ensure compliance with departmental risk management procedures.
- Client Interaction & Communication: Greet and assist clients in person and over the phone, manage diaries, schedule appointments, and coordinate meetings and room bookings for Legal Advisers.
- Administrative & Team Support: Provide general administrative support including photocopying, scanning, and document handling, support and guide other assistants as needed.
- Compliance & Financial Administration: Ensure compliance with internal policies, prepare invoices, assist with billing processes, and complete accounts documentation as directed.
- Professional Development: Participate in training as required and take responsibility for ongoing personal development.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Experience in legal protocols and procedures relevant to Residential Conveyancing is beneficial but not mandatory.
- Strong organisational skills and ability to manage tasks independently.
- Excellent attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
- Professional, approachable, and client-focused manner.
- Ability to work collaboratively within a team and support colleagues.
- Integrity to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.
- Commitment to confidentiality and compliance with regulatory requirements.
- Willingness to learn and develop within the role.

If this is of interest, don't hesitate in applying as the client is actively interviewing.

title: Legal Assistant - Employment
description:
Job Title: Legal Assistant (Employment)
Location: York
Salary: £25,000 - £28,000 per annum
Hours: Monday - Friday, full time permanent

Are you an organised, detail oriented and proactive individual looking to develop your career within a professional and supportive legal environment?

title: Private Client Legal Assistant
company: Clear Legal & Financial Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
An opportunity has arisen for an organised and proactive Legal Assistant to join a busy Private Client team based in Malton.

You will provide essential administrative and secretarial support to Private Client Solicitors, helping to ensure the smooth running of the department and delivering a professional, friendly and efficient service to clients.

The ideal candidate will have previous experience working as a Private Client Legal Assistant, Legal Secretary or in a similar legal support role. However, applications are also welcomed from candidates with a general legal administration background, some knowledge of Private Client law or strong transferable administrative skills.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their legal career within a supportive and professional team.

Legal Administration & Document Production
- Prepare legal documents and correspondence using audio typing, copy typing and standard forms.
- Amend, format and proofread complex legal documents, ensuring accuracy and attention to detail.
- Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence and post.
- Use relevant online platforms to access documents, reports and information.
- Assist with the safe storage and management of client deeds and important documentation.

File & Case Management
- Open, maintain and close client files using the case management system.
- Ensure files and client records are accurate and kept up to date.
- Undertake daily filing, scanning, document retrieval and general file administration.
- Process client identification documents and maintain records in line with internal procedures.

Client Care & Communication
- Deal with client enquiries in person and over the telephone, providing a professional and empathetic service.
- Answer incoming calls, take accurate messages and direct enquiries to the appropriate person.
- Arrange appointments, manage diaries and coordinate meetings and room bookings.
- Maintain positive relationships with clients and colleagues.

Compliance & Professional Development
- Follow internal policies and procedures, including anti-money laundering and risk management requirements.
- Ensure client deeds and sensitive documents are handled and stored securely.
- Participate in relevant training and take responsibility for ongoing professional development.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in a legal support role, such as Private Client Legal Assistant, Legal Secretary or Legal Administrator.
- An understanding of legal procedures and protocols, ideally within Private Client.
- Knowledge of Wills, Probate, Estate Administration, Trusts and Lasting Powers of Attorney would be advantageous.
- Good audio typing, copy typing and document production skills.

Should you have any questions or wish to apply please do not hesitate to contact Clear Legal and Financial.
